parts.text: Drones fly along corridors between named sites, and sites have only so many places where drones can take off and land at the same time. Several dispatchers plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and the same popular drones. Each company's fleet, jobs, sites, and problems are its own business, and while closures can come into force while drones of several companies are already in the air, airspace information is shared because it comes from the authorities and is the same for everyone.
